cases.why: tests are shuffled only inside each file, so a test that depends on another file having run first is never found.
the seed is the same every night, so the job tries one order forever and finds nothing after its first run.
a failed night is a red run and an email, the state every unattended job left behind in Stage 4.
cases.find: python -m src.core.alerts --title "Nightly shuffled suite failing" --body-file shuffled-report.md
